title: ThreadStats
description: A plugin that allows the user to view how server threads are being used.
body:
# **ThreadStats**
  ThreadStats allows administrators to view how the server is using their threads using **/threadstats**. Platform threads, virtual threads, and threads by type are all listed. This is super helpful for finding potential threadleaks and their sources.
